chunks: He will have no strength or helper.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the disbeliever's power and helpers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah by contrasting the fleeting nature of worldly authority with the eternal reality of the Hereafter. It serves as a warning that on the Day of Resurrection, all forms of intercession (shafa'ah) are contingent upon divine permission, leaving the disbeliever utterly isolated without any protector or helper.
